name: plunk
description: Open-source email platform for transactional emails, campaigns and workflows.

AWS_SES_REGION.description: AWS SES region used to send email.

AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS SES access key ID: https://console.aws.amazon.com/iam/

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3-compatible storage endpoint for uploads (e.g. https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com).

S3_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of the S3 bucket, e.g. https://uploads.example.com.

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Set to true for MinIO and other path-style S3 servers.

DISABLE_SIGNUPS.description: Optional. Set to true to block new signups (useful once your account exists).

GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT.description: Optional. GitHub OAuth client ID: https://github.com/settings/developers

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT.description: Optional. Google OAuth client ID: https://console.cloud.google.com/

NTFY_URL.description: Optional. ntfy.sh topic URL for system notifications.

PLUNK_API_KEY.description: Optional. Plunk API key to email users about critical events.
